sharedRules.name: Tractor Beamer
sharedRules.description: At the end of this Ship's activation, you may pick a single friendly Ship with the Payload special rule within 6". Move that ship up to 4" in any direction.

sharedRules.name: Gravitational Lensing
sharedRules.description: Once per round, when determining targets for a friendly ship within 8" of this ship, you may treat one of its weapons as having an Arc of F/S instead of its normal Arcs for that attack.

sharedRules.name: Limited Aegis Bandwidth
sharedRules.description: Friendly Ships with this rule may combine their Aegis values as if they were the same Group. When these Ships combine their Aegis value, only those within 6" of the Group using the benefits of Aegis are counted. A Ship with this rule cannot gain the benefit of Aegis from another Ship with this rule.

sharedRules.name: Summoning Cell
sharedRules.description: When you activate a Wing within 4" of this Ship, instead of moving them normally, you may remove them from the table, then place them anywhere within 18" of this Ship. Wings placed this way suffer the effects of any scenery they are placed on but ignore intervening scenery. Wings placed this way may form and divide into Wings as if they had moved normally.

sharedRules.name: Torpedo
sharedRules.description: This asset is automatically removed during the Cleanup step of the End Phase.

sharedRules.name: High Velocity Boarding Pods
sharedRules.description: This Ship's Boarding Pods may be used against targets up to 6" away.

sharedRules.name: Feature Carrier
sharedRules.description: At the start of the game, before players deploy, choose from the Gravitational Lens or Ghost Orb Tower Deployable Feature. This Ship starts the game carrying the chosen Deployable Feature.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: When you activate this Ship on General Quarters, you may choose to forgo attacking with this Ship. If you do, this Ship goes on Overwatch until the end of the round or until it declares the use of Overwatch. At the end of any enemy Group's activation, if that Group moved through this Ship's Front arc and was in weapons range while doing so, you may declare the use of Overwatch against that Group. When you use Overwatch, this Ship immediately makes an Attack as if on General Quarters against the enemy Group, even if it is out of arc and weapon range.

rules.name: Genitor Tower
rules.description:
This Feature may be purchased for your fleet when you build your list. It must be assigned to a Ship with the Porter special rule as if it were a Ship with the Payload S-1 special rule.
When one or more enemy Battalions on this Dropsite and its Features are removed for any reason, place 2 friendly Battalions on this Dropsite regardless of the number of Battalions removed or Genitor Towers on this Dropsite. If these Battalions are gained through Battalion Combat, they are placed after Battalion Combat.
When this Feature is destroyed, it contributes its points to the Kill Points of the opposing player that destroyed it.

rules.name: Gravitational Arc
rules.description:
When an enemy Group ends its move within 6\" of this Feature's dropsite and in atmosphere, that Group's player rolls a dice. On a 1-3, the Group is moved into Orbit and cannot move into Atmosphere again this round. It suffers the effects of moving through any scenery it is placed in. This takes place before that Group attacks or launches assets. If all Ships in the Group have Orbital Decay tokens, they are not affected.
This feature requires 5 or more Battalions to be removed during Battalion Combat and 5 damage to remove due to attacks.

rules.name: Ghost Orb Tower
rules.description:
When you activate this Feature, remove 1 enemy Battalion from each Feature on this Dropsite, then remove 1 enemy Battalion from anywhere on this Dropsite.
This feature requires 5 or more Battalions to be removed due to Battalion Combat and 5 damage to remove due to Group/Asset attacks.

rules.name: Ghost Orb
rules.description: Effects caused by this weapon's Status rule are removed at the start of next round's End Phase instead of this round's End Phase.
